goal: Prevent a destination-qualified SummonScout client from auto-inviting World summon requests for any other or unknown destination; preserve demand logging and existing grouped-resume behavior, and prune stale mismatched invite queue entries.
notes: Hot Lua guard in the existing SummonScout_RosterOwnershipHot module. It wraps the core EventAPI.handleChannelMessage at runtime, temporarily disables autoInvite for World messages whose classified destination is not in SummonScoutDB.service (or is unknown/ambiguous while serving a specific destination), then restores the user's setting so logging/counter behavior still runs. Existing mismatched queued World invites are pruned on patch. This addresses the actual wrong World auto-invite; the previous roster ownership guard only addressed the secondary party-join summon-pending symptom. Lease was narrowed after preflight run 37188617286 showed an unrelated live SummonScout module-wide lease owned by the combat-resume task; the exact World gate and roster-hot resource remain exclusively leased here.
